title: Apartamento T2 Urbanização Quinta de São Gonçalo, Carcavelos e Parede, Cascais
description:
This exceptional 2-bedroom ground floor apartment in Quinta de Sao Goncalo features a private 49.6 m2 terrace and modern comforts in a prime local near NOVA SBE.
Property Overview:
- 2-bedroom, ground floor apartment
- Private 49.6 m2 terrace
- Private garage parking
- Impeccable condition

Key Features:
- Air conditioning, central heating & hybrid boiler
- Fireplace with heat recovery
- Electric shutters & video intercom
- Jacuzzi
- Fully equipped kitchen

Description:
Nestled in a serene residential enclave, this apartment blends luxury living with a spacious outdoor retreat. The expansive terrace, complete with landscaped flower beds, is perfect for entertaining or relaxation. Inside, top-tier climate control, modern fixtures and a private garage ensure comfort mere steps from the beach and NOVA SBE.

Comment:
This excellent 2-bedroom apartment with a private 49.6 m2 terrace in the prestigious Quinta de São Goncalo Urbanization in Carcavelos offers a ground floor left unit at Rua de Franca no. 60. 
The property is in excellent condition and ideal for personal housing or investment given its proximity to the NOVA School of Business and Economics campus. Key features include landscaped flower beds, air conditioning, central heating, a hybrid boiler, living room with fireplace and heat recovery system, electric shutters, video intercom, jacuzzi, and a fully equipped kitchen.
A private parking space is available in the building garage. The location provides a quiet residential atmosphere with easy access to education institutions such as Marista de Carcavelos College and St. Julian`s School, leisure options with Carcavelos Beach just a 5-minute walk away, and excellent transport links via Avenida Marginal, the A5 Highway, local buses including the Carcavelos SBE stop, and the nearby train station.
